definition: Bounded exact-source API workflow proof for two independent TCE infusion mechanisms; source bindings, behavior, complete rule coverage and release availability are distinct claims
manualBoundaries: Radiant light activation/deactivation, Constitution saving throw against the artificer spell DC, blind condition and end-of-next-turn timing are manual; this proof covers fixed +1 weapon projection and charge bookkeeping only.
Melee hit, reaction availability, action use, dawn occurrence and actual d4 are explicit player confirmations, not a simulated combat round or clock.
The Ring accepts TCE action semantics and exact mundane PHB Signet Ring only; EFA bonus-action magic item is not interchangeable.

Current exact Artificer/optional unique PHB Warlock source grants and source tables are checked without calling resource sync during offers or actions. Historical provenance of already automatic resources cannot be reconstructed.

Actual resource synchronization and disposable first/second/reopened card-view reconciliation preserve currently manual/unknown-owned/locked pools and mirrors, including after forgetting the Ring; this does not reconstruct ownership lost to historical older-client adoption.

Ordinary post-restoration expenditure uses the existing public resource-edit path, not a new ordinary spell-action receipt. The separately learned real PHB invocation uses the actual spell-action API.
Unknown source combinations, imported casting aliases, unsupported protocols and malformed/manual/locked pools remain unavailable without repair or adoption.

Native/linked imports are current-consumer paths; browser storage, real old-consumer compatibility, server recovery, multiplayer delivery and publication require separate evidence. Plain unlinked Owlbear export is not a complete backup.
Long-rest infusion activation, touching, death, external item transfer, other wearers and automatic spell effects remain manual.
